title: New contest

scoringHint: What each dish is judged on, and the score band.

formatLegend: What kind of contest is this?
formatSoloHelp: Each person cooks their own dish and scores every other dish.
formatSoloWithPartners: Everyone on their own, partners kept apart
formatSoloWithPartnersHelp: Each person cooks their own dish. Anyone with a partner doesn’t score their partner’s dish.
formatCouplesHelp: Each couple cooks one dish. Nobody scores their own couple’s dish, and everyone needs a partner.
